# Quasi-harmonic approximation with mini-ref (excerpt)

## Methods

The quasi-harmonic approximation evaluates the Helmholtz free energy on a volume
grid. At each volume, harmonic phonons are obtained from finite-displacement
force constants; F(V,T) is then minimized to give the thermal expansion.

Validity: the harmonic approximation must hold at each volume. Imaginary modes
invalidate the QHA protocol.

## Software

The procedure is implemented in the mini-ref package (this work's companion code).
